description: This Python source file contains functions for managing environment variable mappings between common environment specifications and framework-specific configurations, utilizing YAML templates. It provides utilities to retrieve template paths, parse YAML configurations, apply prefixes and mappings, and support multiple frameworks based on directory structure.

methods.name: Path get_template_path(framework: str)
methods.description: Returns the Path object to the environment template file for a specified framework.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict[str,str]] parse_template_file(template_path: Path)
methods.description: Parses a YAML template file to extract an optional prefix and a mapping dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str)
methods.description: Applies a given prefix to all environment variables in a dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts a set of common environment variables into framework-specific variables based on a YAML template.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts framework-specific environment variables back to common variables according to a YAML template.

methods.name: list get_supported_frameworks()
methods.description: Detects and returns a list of supported frameworks based on existing template directories.

ctags.pattern: /^def apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str) -> Dict[str, str]:$/
